quarterly_data.quarter: Pfizer press release: Pfizer and BioNTech Receive U.S. FDA Approval for (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The FDA approved Pfizer and BioNTech's sBLA for the 2026-2027 COVID-19 vaccine formula targeting the XFG variant (COMIRNATY XFG) for adults 65 and older and people 5 through 64 with at least one high-risk underlying condition; shipping was to begin immediately, with availability in U.S. pharmacies, hospitals and clinics in the coming days. More than five billion doses of COMIRNATY have been distributed globally; BioNTech is the Marketing Authorization Holder in the U.S., EU, UK and other countries.
quarterly_data.figure: more than five billion COMIRNATY doses distributed globally
